items.name: Potion
items.description: Equip and throw [ ] on item - drink
items.effect: Can be used to contain and dispense liquids
items.other: Can be found as a part of some pixel scenes in Mines or spawned in when taking the Eat Your Vegetables perk

items.name: Powder Pouch
items.description: A handy pouch for carrying powdery materials.
items.effect: Can be used to contain and dispense powders

items.name: Broken Wand
items.description: This wand has snapped in half but it still crackles with magical energy
items.effect: Fires random spells when thrown, but could perhaps be repaired

items.name: Egg
items.description: Equip and throw
items.effect: Can be thrown or shot to crack open and spawn a enemy For precise probabilities and details on spawns from eggs, see Egg#Egg types
items.other: Can be summoned from Summon Egg spell

items.name: Toasty egg
items.description: The egg feels very warm

items.name: Chilly egg
items.description: The egg feels cold

items.name: Slimy egg
items.description: The egg is covered in slime

items.name: Kammi
items.description: Can be thrown to summon a cozy hut.
items.effect: When thrown, it summons a wooden hut. After a few seconds, several healing projectiles will bounce around inside, healing you.

items.name: Paha Silmä
items.description: This eye-shaped artefact projects a malevolent glare.
items.effect: Fires a short-ranged red plasma beam, and has other secret uses.
items.other: One will always spawn atop a small spire to the left of the Giant Tree in the Main World

items.name: Kuu
items.description: This tiny celestial object has a strong gravitational pull.
items.effect: Attracts rigid-body items and projectiles, hovers above ground when thrown

items.name: Runestone
items.description: A runestone with a strong magical aura. You feel like kicking it.
items.effect: When active, causes a certain effect within its radius.

items.name: Ukkoskivi
items.description: This small rock makes you feel very charged.
items.effect: Gives Electricity immunity when held, emits lightning shocks to conductive materials, and makes Ukko peaceful
items.other: Using an Essence Eater to discharge an absorbed

items.name: Kiuaskivi
items.description: This tiny rock looks most fiery, but when touched only a pleasant warmth can be felt.
items.effect: Gives fire immunity when held, burns flammable materials, evaporates liquids, and makes Stendari peaceful
items.other: Using an Essence Eater to discharge an absorbed

items.name: Vuoksikivi
items.description: This small rock is hard and solid, yet seems to be gushing with water.
items.effect: When held, protects from fire and turns lava into volcanic rock that will not melt. It will also wash off any stain and replace it with .
items.other: Using an Essence Eater to discharge an absorbed

items.name: Kakkakikkare
items.description: This mysterious spiral-shaped artefact smells horrible and feels warm to the touch.
items.effect: When held, turns all nearby liquid into Excrement. Additionally, causes you and all nearby enemies to take damage and vomit. Creates an infinite amount of excrement when thrown.
items.other: Using an Essence Eater to discharge an absorbed

items.name: Shiny Orb
items.description: It hums slightly. What happens if you kick it, you wonder...
items.effect: When kicked, it can produce a small number of Gold Nuggets, but each kick increases the chance for it to explode instead. The '''Shiny Orb''' is lost in the process.

items.name: Cruel Orb
items.description: It seems to trickle with blood...
items.effect: Same as the '''Shiny Orb''', but instead summons Blood Gold; the explosion is also much larger and more likely to occur.

items.name: Chaos Die
items.description: Roll it for various prizes!
items.effect: When kicked, thrown, shot or damaged in some way, it will roll its face and pick between 6 main effects and 2 significantly rarer ones

items.name: Greed Die
items.description: The name may be more apt than one thinks.
items.effect: Similar to the Chaos Die, but with much more extreme effects

items.name: Sampo
items.description: This has been said to complete the Work
items.effect: Triggers game end. †''Its name changes based on number of orbs collected.''
items.other: One will always spawn in the Final Boss arena in the Main World |} == List of Special Items == These are items that cannot be found on Item Pedestals or from Chests. Most of these either have esoteric acquisition methods and/or are non-renewable {| class="wikitable sortable sticky-headers mw-collapsible"

items.name: Egg
items.description: Equip and throw
items.effect: Can be thrown or shot to crack open and spawn a enemy. For precise probabilities and details on spawns from eggs, see .

items.name: Wiggling Egg
items.description: Something wiggles inside

items.name: Hollow Egg
items.description: I wonder if there's anything inside?
items.effect: Acts as a trigger spell that can be picked up and broken whenever the holder wishes to discharge the held payload. Without any spells in it, the egg will simply do nothing when broken.

items.name: Tannerkivi
items.description: It looks like it could stand the test of aeons.
items.effect: Turns nearby solid materials into Soil when held and causes your kicks to create a miniature earthquake around you.

items.name: Broken Spell
items.description: A malfunctioning spell
items.effect: Can be repaired to unlock an unusual spell. See the Broken Spell article for details.

items.name: Crystal Key
items.description: The key is voiceless.
items.effect: Once given a voice, can be used to unlock certain secrets. See the Crystal Key article for details.

items.name: Emerald Tablet
items.description: (Varies)
items.effect: There are multiple tablets, each with a different description. See Emerald Tablet for a list of all known tablets and their descriptions.

items.name: Stone Tablet
items.description: (Varies)
items.effect: Some of the Emerald Tablets can be transformed to reveal an additional message. There are multiple Stone Tablets, each with a different description. See Stone Tablet for a list of all known Stone Tablets and their descriptions.

items.name: Book
items.description: (Varies)
items.effect: There are multiple books, each with a different description. See Books for a list of all known books and their descriptions.

items.name: Notes on Grand Alchemy
items.description: (Varies)
items.effect: There are multiple secret Notebooks hidden around the world, each with a different description. See Notes on Grand Alchemy for a list of all known Notebooks and their descriptions.

items.name: Refreshing Gourd
items.description: Can be thrown to deal damage. Upon breaking, releases a refreshing aura.
items.effect: Creates a very brief Circle of Vigour when broken. And other strange uses.

items.name: Auringonsiemen
items.description: It glows, full of promise.
items.effect: Gives the All-Seeing Eye perk effect, and converts powder materials into exploding gunpowder.

items.name: Aurinkokivi
items.description: The essence of the Sun, crystallized
items.effect: Gives the All-Seeing Eye perk effect, and converts powder materials into fire. {{spoiler|Detonating 6 explosive spells in the span of one second will transform it into an .}}

items.name: Kuulokivi
items.description: This artefact is covered in note-shaped engravings and is pulsing at a steady pace. Is that sound distant music?
items.effect: When held, it plays the music from the biome you are currently in. And other strange uses.

items.name: Sädekivi
items.description: This artefact has a picture of a celestial beam.
items.effect: When kicked, creates a beam of light that will damage creatures and destroy all ground directly above. This applies retroactively to previously visited unloaded chunks, and not-yet-visited chunks.

items.name: Sauvan Ydin
items.description: This artefact can open the potential of wands to you even without perks...
items.effect: Lets you edit wands when held, and transmutes nearby non-magical liquids into Concentrated Mana.

ALWAYS_CAST.name: Always Cast
ALWAYS_CAST.description: A random Always Cast spell is added to the wand in your hand, up to a maximum of 4.

ANGRY_GHOST.name: Angry Ghost
ANGRY_GHOST.description: An angry spirit comes to your aid, copying nearby spells and projectiles.

ABILITY_ACTIONS_MATERIALIZED.name: Bombs Materialized
ABILITY_ACTIONS_MATERIALIZED.description: Bomb-like spells can be placed in the ITEMS space in inventory and used like throwable items.

PROJECTILE_HOMING_SHOOTER.name: Boomerang Spells
PROJECTILE_HOMING_SHOOTER.description: Your spells arc towards you, but gain extra speed and deal extra damage.

BOUNCE.name: Bouncing Spells
BOUNCE.description: Almost all your spells bounce around and last longer.

BREATH_UNDERWATER.name: Breathless
BREATH_UNDERWATER.description: You can no longer drown, and can move in liquids with ease.

RISKY_CRITICAL.name: Close Call
RISKY_CRITICAL.description: You gain additional chance to deal critical hits as long as there are enemies near you.

LOWER_SPREAD.name: Concentrated Spells
LOWER_SPREAD.description: Your spells have lower spread and extra damage, but have increased cast delay.

CONTACT_DAMAGE.name: Contact Damage
CONTACT_DAMAGE.description: Enemies near you take damage, the damage is higher the lower your health gets.

CORDYCEPS.name: Cordyceps
CORDYCEPS.description: Fungal creatures spawn from the corpses of enemies killed by you.

DISSOLVE_POWDERS.name: Dissolve Powders
DISSOLVE_POWDERS.description: Sand and other soft, powdery materials dissolve quickly in your presence.

FOOD_CLOCK.name: Eat Your Vegetables
FOOD_CLOCK.description: You inflict more damage the more satiated you are, but you start losing health if your stomach is empty.

ELECTRICITY.name: Electricity
ELECTRICITY.description: You're immune to electric damage, but metal and liquids around you electrify constantly. Look out!

PROTECTION_ELECTRICITY.name: Electricity Immunity
PROTECTION_ELECTRICITY.description: You take no damage from electric shocks.

ESSENCE_AIR.name: Essence of Air
ESSENCE_AIR.description: Your being controls the air around you!

ESSENCE_ALCOHOL.name: Essence of Spirits
ESSENCE_ALCOHOL.description: That was not the best of ideas

EXPLODING_CORPSES.name: Exploding Corpses
EXPLODING_CORPSES.description: Enemies explode upon death, but you gain immunity to explosive damage.

EXPLODING_GOLD.name: Exploding Gold
EXPLODING_GOLD.description: Nuggets of gold explode once they expire or are picked up.

PROTECTION_EXPLOSION.name: Explosion Immunity
PROTECTION_EXPLOSION.description: You take no direct damage from explosions.

EXTRA_SHOP_ITEM.name: Extra Item in Holy Mountain
EXTRA_SHOP_ITEM.description: There will be an additional item in every Holy Mountain you haven't discovered yet.

EXTRA_KNOCKBACK.name: Extra Knockback on Spells
EXTRA_KNOCKBACK.description: Your spells knock enemies around with more force.

RESPAWN.name: Extra Life
RESPAWN.description: Upon death you respawn with 100 health.

EXTRA_PERK.name: Extra Perk
EXTRA_PERK.description: From now on you will find an extra perk in every Holy Mountain.

EXTRA_POTION_CAPACITY.name: Extra Potion Capacity
EXTRA_POTION_CAPACITY.description: Potions can contain 80% more liquid, and potions you find will have that much to start with.

EXTRA_SLOTS.name: Extra Wand Capacity
EXTRA_SLOTS.description: The wands you're currently carrying gain 1-3 additional spell slots (to a maximum of 25).

FAST_PROJECTILES.name: Faster Projectiles
FAST_PROJECTILES.description: Your projectile spells fly faster than before.

FASTER_WANDS.name: Faster Wands
FASTER_WANDS.description: All wands you're currently carrying gain a bonus to their cast delay & reload time.

WORM_SMALLER_HOLES.name: Feared by Worms
WORM_SMALLER_HOLES.description: Worms run away from you, and worm and lukki enemies no longer destroy terrain while burrowing.

PROTECTION_FIRE.name: Fire Immunity
PROTECTION_FIRE.description: You take no damage from fire.

MOLD.name: Fungal Colony
MOLD.description: Slime near you spontaneously turns into fungal creatures.

FUNGAL_DISEASE.name: Fungal Disease
FUNGAL_DISEASE.description: When near danger, you sprout fungal growths.

BLEED_GAS.name: Gas Blood
BLEED_GAS.description: You bleed flammable gas instead of blood.

GLASS_CANNON.name: Glass Cannon
GLASS_CANNON.description: Your spells deal 5x damage and have larger blast ranges, but your maximum health is capped to 50.

ADVENTURER.name: Healthy Exploration
ADVENTURER.description: Every time you visit a new area, you regain 60 health.

EXTRA_MANA.name: High Mana, Low Capacity
EXTRA_MANA.description: Your currently held wand loses half its capacity, but gains more mana.

PROJECTILE_HOMING.name: Homing Shots
PROJECTILE_HOMING.description: Your spells home towards enemies very slightly.

HOMUNCULUS.name: Homunculus
HOMUNCULUS.description: Every time you leave a Holy Mountain, a helpful homunculus is summoned.

HUNGRY_GHOST.name: Hungry Ghost
HUNGRY_GHOST.description: Summons a happy minion who'll eat enemy projectile every now and then.

INVISIBILITY.name: Invisibility
INVISIBILITY.description: You're invisible. Stains, casting spells, kicking and taking damage makes you temporarily visible.

IRON_STOMACH.name: Iron Stomach
IRON_STOMACH.description: You no longer suffer from negative effects of eating.

MANA_FROM_KILLS.name: Kills to Mana
MANA_FROM_KILLS.description: Every time an enemy near you dies, you release mana-recharging liquid.

LEGGY_FEET.name: Leggy Mutation
LEGGY_FEET.description: You grow disturbing looking limbs that fight for you.

LEVITATION_TRAIL.name: Levitation Trail
LEVITATION_TRAIL.description: When levitating, you leave a trail of magical sparks that harm passing creatures.

LOW_HP_DAMAGE_BOOST.name: Living on the Edge
LOW_HP_DAMAGE_BOOST.description: Your spells deal 3x damage when you're under 25 HP or 25% of maximum health.

LOW_GRAVITY.name: Low Gravity
LOW_GRAVITY.description: All creatures, you included, have lower personal gravity.

LOW_RECOIL.name: Low Recoil
LOW_RECOIL.description: Recoil caused by your spells is greatly reduced, but your spells fly slightly slower.

LUKKI_MINION.name: Lukki Minion
LUKKI_MINION.description: Summons a lukki minion to your help.

ATTACK_FOOT.name: Lukki Mutation
ATTACK_FOOT.description: You grow curious additional limbs that fight for you.

PROTECTION_MELEE.name: Melee Immunity
PROTECTION_MELEE.description: You take no damage from close-range enemy attacks.

GENOME_MORE_HATRED.name: More Hatred
GENOME_MORE_HATRED.description: Creatures become more aggressive towards each other.

GENOME_MORE_LOVE.name: More Love
GENOME_MORE_LOVE.description: Creatures in the world are more friendly to each other.

DEATH_GHOST.name: Mournful Spirit
DEATH_GHOST.description: Dying creatures leave behind a spirit that deals damage in a small area.

STRONG_KICK.name: Never Skip Leg Day
STRONG_KICK.description: Your kicks deal extra damage and knockback.

NO_MORE_KNOCKBACK.name: No More Knockback
NO_MORE_KNOCKBACK.description: Enemies can no longer knock you back.

NO_MORE_SHUFFLE.name: No More Shuffle
NO_MORE_SHUFFLE.description: Most of the wands will be non shuffling. The wands you carry with you turn into non-shufflers too.

NO_WAND_EDITING.name: No Wand Tinkering
NO_WAND_EDITING.description: Wands cannot be tinkered with, but enemies may drop blood money.

BLEED_OIL.name: Oil Blood
BLEED_OIL.description: You bleed flammable oil, but are immune to fire.

PEACE_WITH_GODS.name: Peace with Gods
PEACE_WITH_GODS.description: You make peace with your Gods.

PERKS_LOTTERY.name: Perk Lottery
PERKS_LOTTERY.description: When you pick a perk, there's a 50% chance the others won't disappear.

SHIELD.name: Permanent Shield
SHIELD.description: You gain a small, permanent shield.

PERSONAL_LASER.name: Personal Plasma Beam
PERSONAL_LASER.description: You constantly fire a devastating plasma beam, but you fire spells much slower.

LASER_AIM.name: Pinpointer
LASER_AIM.description: Your spells fly faster and have lower spread, and you have a handy sightline for aiming!

PLAGUE_RATS.name: Plague Rats
PLAGUE_RATS.description: Dying enemies release rats to serve your bidding! All rats become your friend.

DUPLICATE_PROJECTILE.name: Projectile Duplication
DUPLICATE_PROJECTILE.description: Your projectile spells have a chance to duplicate, but you're more vulnerable to projectile damage

PROJECTILE_EATER_SECTOR.name: Projectile Eater
PROJECTILE_EATER_SECTOR.description: Projectiles that fly into a small sector behind you disappear.

PROJECTILE_REPULSION.name: Projectile Repulsion Field
PROJECTILE_REPULSION.description: Most projectiles are repulsed by your presence, but you take slightly more projectile damage.

PROJECTILE_REPULSION_SECTOR.name: Projectile Repulsion Sector
PROJECTILE_REPULSION_SECTOR.description: Projectiles that fly into a small sector in front of you get blown away.

ANGRY_LEVITATION.name: Rage-fueled Levitation
ANGRY_LEVITATION.description: Killing an enemy makes you replenish some of your levitation power.

REPELLING_CAPE.name: Repelling Cape
REPELLING_CAPE.description: Stains drop at a fast rate (when moving).

REVENGE_BULLET.name: Revenge Bullets
REVENGE_BULLET.description: You return fire when hit by projectiles, and gain 20% resistance against explosions and projectiles.

REVENGE_EXPLOSION.name: Revenge Explosion
REVENGE_EXPLOSION.description: You release a magical explosion upon taking damage, and gain 25% resistance against explosions.

REVENGE_RATS.name: Revenge Rats
REVENGE_RATS.description: When you take damage, there's a chance that a helpful rat minion is summoned.

REVENGE_TENTACLE.name: Revenge Tentacle
REVENGE_TENTACLE.description: You summon a monstrous tentacle upon taking damage, and gain 25% resistance against projectiles.

SAVING_GRACE.name: Saving Grace
SAVING_GRACE.description: If you would die and have more than 1 HP, your HP is set to 1 instead.

BLEED_SLIME.name: Slime Blood
BLEED_SLIME.description: You bleed slime, but slime no longer slows you down and you have higher projectile resistance.

MAP.name: Spatial Awareness
MAP.description: If you stop for a moment, you can sense your location relative to the Mountain.

VOMIT_RATS.name: Spontaneous Generation
VOMIT_RATS.description: Vomit near you evolves into helpful rat minions.

STAINLESS_ARMOUR.name: Stainless Armour
STAINLESS_ARMOUR.description: You take 50% less damage as long as you have no active stain status effect.

HEARTS_MORE_EXTRA_HP.name: Stronger Hearts
HEARTS_MORE_EXTRA_HP.description: Hearts bestow double the maximum HP.

MEGA_BEAM_STONE.name: Summon Sädekivi
MEGA_BEAM_STONE.description: You gain an artefact that allows you to call the celestial rage.

TELEPORTITIS.name: Teleportitis
TELEPORTITIS.description: You take 20% less damage. You teleport away every time you're hurt.

TELEPORTITIS_DODGE.name: Teleportitis Dodge
TELEPORTITIS_DODGE.description: You teleport a short distance away when an enemy projectile is near.

EDIT_WANDS_EVERYWHERE.name: Tinker with Wands Everywhere
EDIT_WANDS_EVERYWHERE.description: A divine blessing allows you to tinker with wands everywhere.

PROTECTION_RADIOACTIVITY.name: Toxic Immunity
PROTECTION_RADIOACTIVITY.description: You take no damage from toxic sludge and other toxic things.

TRICK_BLOOD_MONEY.name: Trick Blood Money
TRICK_BLOOD_MONEY.description: Blood money is dropped when death is an accident.

EXTRA_MONEY_TRICK_KILL.name: Trick Greed
EXTRA_MONEY_TRICK_KILL.description: 4x instead of 2x gold is dropped when death is an accident.

VAMPIRISM.name: Vampirism
VAMPIRISM.description: You lose 25% maximum health, but can replenish health by drinking blood.Blood doesn't affect satiation level and you no longer suffer from food poisoning.

WAND_EXPERIMENTER.name: Wand Experimenter
WAND_EXPERIMENTER.description: Firing newly found and unmodified wands heals you.
